proceso.titulo: 100% Remote Assisted Reset via USB connection
proceso.introTexto: Here's how the connection works before you message us on WhatsApp:
proceso.paso1Texto: You need a PC with Windows 11, 10, or 8. Open WhatsApp Web on that same computer and connect your printer with a USB cable. You'll also need to download the secure connection module.
proceso.paso2Texto: Open the program and enter the technician ID shown below. In "Additional information", type your name.
proceso.paso3Texto: Unplug the printer's USB cable, wait 5 seconds, and plug it back in so it can be detected correctly.
proceso.paso4Titulo: Contact us on WhatsApp for your free online review
proceso.paso4Texto: Message us with your printer's brand, model, and error. We'll evaluate your case at no cost and confirm if the assisted reset applies.
proceso.pasoFinalTexto: Once you finish these steps, message us on WhatsApp to continue the assisted process.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions | ResetEnLinea.com
faq.description: We answer the most common questions about printer resets and our assistance process.
faq.heading: Frequently asked questions

items.pregunta: Does this site offer a free program to reset my printer myself?
items.respuesta: No. We don't distribute free reset programs or self-service tools. This is a 100% assisted service: a real technician guides you over WhatsApp through the whole process.

items.pregunta: Is it safe to reset my printer?
items.respuesta: Yes. We work with a prior diagnosis and professional guidance throughout the procedure.

items.pregunta: Is it safe to share my printer's USB connection?
items.respuesta: Yes. We only share your printer's USB connection: we never see your screen, access your files, or control your computer. You stay in control at all times.

items.pregunta: Do I need to disable my antivirus?
items.respuesta: No. We never ask you to disable your antivirus or any security system on your device.

items.pregunta: What do I need for remote assistance?
items.respuesta: A stable internet connection and your printer connected to your computer via USB.
We first evaluate your case and confirm that your model and error are compatible. Only after that confirmation do we quote the price and arrange payment.

items.pregunta: Do I get any proof of the service?
items.respuesta: Yes. Once the reset is done, you receive a warranty certificate for the service performed.

items.pregunta: What if my device doesn't meet the requirements?
items.respuesta: We evaluate alternatives, including a local procedure guided over a USB connection.
